{"sql":"SELECT
  age_band,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM marts.dim_customer_public
GROUP BY age_band
ORDER BY age_band"}

{"sql":"SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM marts.fct_orders
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY payment_method"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date ASC) AS rank,
  order_date,
  orders
FROM marts.mart_daily_kpis
ORDER BY orders DESC, order_date ASC
LIMIT 3"}
{"sql":"SELECT rule_id, table_name, description, severity, action, rows_checked, rows_failed, failed_pct, checked_at\nFROM governance.dq_results\nWHERE rows_failed > 0"}

{"sql":"SELECT model, mape
FROM forecast.accuracy
WHERE metric = 'orders'
  AND scope = 'National'
ORDER BY mape ASC
LIMIT 1"}

{"sql":"SELECT forecast
FROM forecast.next_days
WHERE metric = 'orders'
  AND scope = 'National'
  AND model = 'ets'
  AND CAST(target_date AS DATE) = DATE '2026-07-01';"}

{"sql":"SELECT city, SUM(gmv) AS gmv
FROM marts.mart_city_daily
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY gmv DESC
LIMIT 10"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  month_start,
  SUM(orders) AS orders
FROM marts.mart_daily_kpis
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  date_trunc('month', order_date)::DATE AS month_start,
  SUM(orders) AS orders
FROM marts.mart_daily_kpis
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  payment_method,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_cancelled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_share
FROM marts.fct_orders
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY payment_method"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type,
  AVG(orders) AS average_orders_per_day
FROM marts.mart_daily_kpis
GROUP BY is_weekend
ORDER BY is_weekend DESC"}

{"sql":"SELECT primary_cuisine, COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM marts.dim_restaurant
WHERE primary_cuisine IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY primary_cuisine
ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC
LIMIT 1"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  order_hour,
  AVG(delivery_time_min) AS average_delivery_time_min
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_delivered = TRUE
GROUP BY order_hour
ORDER BY order_hour"}

{"sql":"SELECT gmv_rank_in_city AS rank, restaurant_name, gmv
FROM marts.mart_restaurant_performance
WHERE city = 'Bangalore'
  AND gmv_rank_in_city <= 5
ORDER BY gmv_rank_in_city ASC"}

{"sql":"SELECT p90_delivery_min
FROM marts.mart_delivery_sla
WHERE city = 'Mumbai'
  AND order_hour = 20"}

{"sql":"SELECT review_month, avg_rating
FROM marts.mart_review_insights
WHERE city = 'Delhi'
  AND review_month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND review_month < DATE '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY review_month"}
{"sql":"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reviews_before_order), 0) AS reviews_dated_before_order\nFROM marts.mart_review_insights;"}
{"sql":"SELECT SUM(refunded_orders)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(orders), 0) AS refunded_order_share\nFROM marts.mart_city_daily;"}

{"sql":"SELECT city, SUM(orders) AS total_orders
FROM marts.mart_city_daily
GROUP BY city
HAVING SUM(orders) >= 500000
ORDER BY total_orders DESC"}

{"sql":"SELECT order_hour, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM marts.fct_orders
GROUP BY order_hour
ORDER BY orders DESC, order_hour
LIMIT 1"}

{"sql":"WITH dish_units AS (
    SELECT
        oi.food_id,
        f.food_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM marts.fct_order_items AS oi
    JOIN marts.dim_food AS f
        ON oi.food_id = f.food_id
    GROUP BY oi.food_id, f.food_name
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        food_name,
        units_sold,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC, food_name) AS rank
    FROM dish_units
)
SELECT rank, food_name, units_sold
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY rank"}

{"sql":"WITH city_gmv AS (
    SELECT city, SUM(gmv) AS gmv
    FROM marts.mart_city_daily
    GROUP BY city
), top_10 AS (
    SELECT SUM(gmv) AS top_10_gmv
    FROM (
        SELECT gmv
        FROM city_gmv
        ORDER BY gmv DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) t
), total AS (
    SELECT SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv
    FROM city_gmv
)
SELECT top_10.top_10_gmv / total.total_gmv AS top_10_city_gmv_share
FROM top_10
CROSS JOIN total"}

{"sql":"WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', order_date)::DATE AS month,
        SUM(orders) AS orders
    FROM marts.mart_daily_kpis
    GROUP BY 1
), changes AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        (orders - LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0
            / NULLIF(LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS month_on_month_pct_change
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT
    month,
    month_on_month_pct_change
FROM changes
WHERE month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND month < DATE '2027-01-01'
ORDER BY month"}
{"sql":"SELECT occupation, AVG(lifetime_orders) AS average_lifetime_orders_per_customer\nFROM marts.dim_customer_public\nGROUP BY occupation"}

{"sql":"WITH top_cities AS (
    SELECT city
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    GROUP BY city
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 3
), payment_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.city,
        o.payment_method,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.city
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        ) AS payment_rank
    FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
    INNER JOIN top_cities AS t
        ON o.city = t.city
    GROUP BY o.city, o.payment_method
)
SELECT city, payment_method, order_count
FROM payment_counts
WHERE payment_rank = 1
ORDER BY order_count DESC, city"}

{"sql":"SELECT AVG(o.sales_amount) AS average_sales_amount
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.fct_order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_food AS f
  ON oi.food_id = f.food_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.sales_amount
HAVING BOOL_AND(f.is_veg = TRUE)"}
{"sql":"SELECT\n  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lifetime_orders > 1)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lifetime_orders > 0), 0) AS share_customers_more_than_one_order\nFROM marts.dim_customer_public"}

{"sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS restaurant_count
FROM marts.mart_restaurant_performance
WHERE listed_rating >= 4.5
  AND orders >= 100;"}
{"sql":"SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', order_date, review_date)) AS avg_days_after_order\nFROM marts.fct_reviews;"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  date_trunc('month', order_date)::DATE AS month
FROM marts.mart_daily_kpis
GROUP BY 1
HAVING AVG(orders) > 10000
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  city,
  SUM(sla_breaches) / NULLIF(SUM(delivered_orders), 0) AS sla_breach_share
FROM marts.mart_delivery_sla
GROUP BY city
HAVING SUM(delivered_orders) >= 10000
ORDER BY sla_breach_share DESC
LIMIT 1"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  city,
  DATE '2026-05-01' AS month,
  SUM(gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(delivered_orders), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM marts.mart_city_daily
WHERE city = 'Pune'
  AND order_date >= DATE '2026-05-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY city"}

{"sql":"SELECT
  oi.order_item_id,
  r.city,
  SUM(oi.line_amount) AS total_sales_amount
FROM marts.fct_order_items AS oi
JOIN marts.dim_restaurant AS r
  ON oi.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, r.city"}
